identifier.description: The uuid of the battery forecast

strategy.description: Optimization strategy used for this forecast

forecastQuality.description: The quality score of the forecast (0–100)

forecastDuration.description: The duration of the forecast in hours

forecastTime.description: The timestamp when the forecast was generated

time.description: Interval boundary for the price (15-minute resolution, UTC)

strategies.description: Optimization strategies to include. Omit to compute all supported strategies.

prices.description: Electricity prices (EUR/kWh) for the forecast window. Omit to fall back to EPEX day-ahead prices (same behaviour as the GET endpoint). When provided, entries must be on 15-minute boundaries and exactly 15 minutes apart.

capacity.description: The capacity of the phase in amps

identifier.description: The uuid of the grid connection

type.description: The type of the grid connection [UNKNOWN = 0, SINGLE_PHASE = 1, THREE_PHASE = 2, UNRECOGNIZED = -1]

phaseOneCapacity.description: The capacity of phase one in amps

phaseTwoCapacity.description: The capacity of phase two in amps

phaseThreeCapacity.description: The capacity of phase three in amps

installationDate.description: The timestamp this grid connection was installed.

endDate.description: The timestamp this grid connection was ended.
